name: controlled-charge-server
description: Server for Controlled Charge - a focus-powered group bomb-defusal game

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('web/node_modules',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npx --yes pnpm -C web install && npx --yes pnpm -C web approve-builds --all -y && npx --yes pnpm -C web run build
